sections.title: A Commitment to Righteousness
observations: The psalmist begins with a declaration of intent to live a life of integrity and righteousness. This sets the tone for the entire psalm, emphasizing the importance of personal commitment to godly living.
The phrase 'I will sing of steadfast love and justice' indicates a deep appreciation for God's character, which serves as a model for the psalmist's own life.

sections.title: Rejecting Wickedness
observations: The psalmist expresses a strong aversion to wickedness and deceit. This rejection is not merely passive; it is an active decision to distance oneself from evil influences.
The commitment to not set before his eyes anything that is worthless highlights the importance of guarding one's heart and mind against temptation.

sections.title: The Company We Keep
observations: The psalmist reflects on the importance of community and the influence of those around us. He declares that he will not associate with those who practice deceit or wickedness.
This section serves as a reminder that our relationships can significantly impact our spiritual walk.

sections.title: The Blessing of Integrity
observations: The psalmist concludes with a promise that those who walk in integrity will be blessed. This reinforces the idea that a life committed to righteousness leads to divine favor and blessing.

importantVerses.commentary: The psalmist's commitment to singing of God's love and justice sets a foundational tone for the entire psalm, emphasizing the importance of worship in the life of a believer.
The rejection of wickedness and the commitment to not look upon anything worthless highlights the necessity of discernment in a believer's life.

questions: What does it mean to live a life of integrity in today's world?
How can we actively reject wickedness in our daily lives?
In what ways do our relationships influence our spiritual journey?
What are the practical steps we can take to ensure we are surrounding ourselves with the right company?
